_comment: FORGE frontend catalogue ENGLISH – mirror of de.json. Every key in de.json must exist here (checked by bin/i18n-check.js), including identical {placeholder} sets. Domain terms (Range, Tier, Score, Pool, PnL, APR, Out of Range) stay English in both languages. Book title and author name are never translated.
notif.title: Notifications
overview.tip.pnl24h.title: PnL 24h
overview.tip.pnl24h: Profit/loss over the past 24 hours (rolling window), taken straight from the respective bot dashboard.
overview.tip.apr24h.title: APR 24h
overview.tip.apr24h: Annualised return based on the past 24 hours (rolling window), taken straight from the respective bot dashboard.
login.quotes_error: ⚠ quotes.json could not be loaded – JSON error or file missing.
liq.tip.wallet.title: Wallet
liq.tip.wallet: Full wallet holdings including the SOL reserve for transaction fees – see Total for the amount actually available for trading.
liq.tip.total.title: Total
liq.tip.total: Wallet balance minus the SOL reserve for transaction fees (default 0.10 SOL), plus LP value and unclaimed fees. The reserve is not available as trading capital but stays in your wallet – which is why Total is lower than Wallet.
liq.tip.fee_apr_24h.title: Fee APR (24h, net)
liq.tip.fee_apr_24h: Annualised net return based on the past 24h: (Claimed Fees − Costs) / baseline capital × 365. Average across all active pools.
liq.tip.costs.title: Costs
liq.tip.costs: Total of all Solana transaction costs (in USDC) for today – fees, rebalancing and other actions that reduce the balance. Click to see individual transactions.
liq.tip.claimed_fees.title: Claimed Fees
liq.tip.claimed_fees: LP fees claimed today in USDC (regardless of reinvest/transfer).
liq.tip.fee_apr.title: Fee APR
liq.tip.fee_apr: Annualised net return based on claimed fees: (Claimed Fees − Costs) / baseline capital × 365. Identical to the APR value at the top right.
liq.tip.pnl.title: PnL
liq.tip.pnl: Profit & loss: change in total portfolio value since the start of the day (00:00). Includes LP value changes, price movements and impermanent loss – across all pools.
liq.slow_cadence_tip: The 1 h window holds {have} of the {need} data points required. Pools without capital are updated at a longer interval (saves Helius calls), so one hour is not enough for a slope. This is not a fault. Pick 6 h or longer, where all pools are complete.
liq.claims_scope_position: Only claims of the current position, opened
liq.tip.pnl_best: The highest level of My share since the measurement start: value minus deposited, as a return on what was deposited at that time. Above it: when it was reached.
liq.tip.pnl_worst: The lowest point since the measurement start, on the same basis as the best. Need not be negative: if the pool was never in the red, it is the lowest gain.
liq.bd_market_missing: A USD price is missing for at least one token, so the price development is included in the row below.
liq.tip.bd_fees_reinvested: Fees the bot claimed and put back into the pool, including those claimed right before a rebalance.
liq.tip.bd_il_only: What the pool loses compared to simply holding: it sells when prices rise and buys when they fall. Excludes rebalance costs (own row).
liq.tip.bd_rebalancing: What did not go back into the position during rebalances: swap fees, slippage, price movement between closing and reopening, and the rest left in the wallet. Estimated, so approximate.
liq.tip.bd_invested: Your own capital since the measurement start: opening value plus all later deposits, minus withdrawals. Reinvested fees and top-ups after rebalances are not deposits, that is money that was already in the pool.
liq.tip.bd_market: What your money would have made if you had simply held both tokens: each deposit swapped half into each token at its time and valued today, minus deposited. Below: the price change of both tokens since the measurement start.
liq.tip.bd_value: Your share today, as in the Share column.
liq.pnl_leftover_tooltip: Amount not fully reinvested during a rebalance. Stays in the wallet, is part of your capital, not a loss.
liq.pnl_leftover_estimated_tooltip: Rebalances before this feature didn't record the exact leftover. Roughly approximated from position value before/after the rebalance — skewed by tx costs, slippage and price movement. Replaced by the exact value with the next rebalance.
liq.pnl_fee_income_tooltip: Trading fees claimed from this pool since deposit.
liq.invest_blocked_tvl: TVL is below the TVL protection threshold ({threshold}).
liq.invest_blocked_tvl_unknown: No TVL reading available for this pool – it is skipped until there is one.
liq.invest_blocked_note: The pool joins the ranking again automatically once the rule no longer applies.
liq.vol_mid_desc: Medium volatility – balanced between PnL and fee APR
liq.vol_high_desc: High volatility – fee-APR-weighted, PnL deliberately damped
liq.vol_rwa_desc: RWA (real-world asset) – PnL-weighted, no crypto price trend
liq.vol_norebal_desc: Rebalance-free – PnL counts heavily, low fee APR is normal here
liq.premium_waiting: Waiting for the first premium data set.
liq.premium_next_cycle: Data should be available with the next bot cycle.
liq.np_tip_fee_model: Estimate for {basis} USDC: fees measured from the pool volume of the last 24 h (after Orca's share), price loss roughly estimated. For volatile pairs the price loss is the bigger uncertainty.
liq.tip.chart_open: Opens the price and fee chart for this pool.
liq.tip.range_open: Opens the current price range and coin distribution of the position.
liq.tip.rebalances: Number of rebalances today. A rebalance closes the current position and reopens it with an adjusted price range.
liq.edge_explain: Edge (trading term): the pool's lead over simply holding both tokens, in USDC per hour or per day. Positive means the pool beats holding.
liq.edge_explain_forecast: Edge (trading term): the pool's forecast lead over simply holding both tokens. Positive means the pool is expected to beat holding.
liq.tip.pool_settings_desc: Opens the settings for this pool.
liq.np_forecast: Model forecast of net return for all pools in the selected time window. Calculated from current fee APR, volatility and estimated impermanent loss using the range advisor model. Basis: 1,000 USDC.
liq.score_inactive: Premium not active – the edge forecast in the opportunity table is delivered via the premium data service. Trailing stop and TVL protection continue to work independently.
liq.unreliable_note: ⚠ Unreliable for volatile pools on short time windows (6h/12h)
len.tip.yield_apr_24h.title: Yield APR (24h, net)
len.tip.yield_apr_24h: Annualised net return based on the past 24h: (Yield − Payed Fees) / total capital × 365. Rolling over today and yesterday (time-weighted).
len.apr_estimate.title: Estimated value
len.apr_estimate: With this little capital, your 24h yield rounds to 0.00 USDC – no meaningful return could be calculated from that. We're showing the protocol's currently reported interest rate instead.
len.no_history_pool: No history data for this pool yet.
len.no_deposits_period: No deposits or withdrawals in this period.
len.no_tvl_history_pool: No TVL history for this pool yet.
len.tip.payed_fees_today: Total of all Solana transaction fees (in USDC) for deposits/withdrawals today. Click for a breakdown.
len.tip.payed_fees_yesterday: Total of all Solana transaction fees (in USDC) for deposits/withdrawals yesterday. Click for a breakdown.
len.tip.payed_fees_month: Total of all Solana transaction fees (in USDC) for deposits/withdrawals this month. Click for a breakdown.
len.tip.yield_today: Accumulated USDC return from all lending positions today. Click for the daily curve.
len.tip.yield_yesterday: Accumulated USDC return from all lending positions yesterday. Click for details.
len.tip.yield_month: Accumulated USDC return from all lending positions this month. Click for the daily curve.
len.tip.yield_apr_today: Annualised return based on today’s yield: yield / total capital × 365.
len.tip.yield_apr_yesterday: Annualised return based on yesterday’s yield: yield / total capital × 365.
len.tip.yield_apr_month: Annualised return based on the monthly yield: yield / total capital × 365, extrapolated to one year.
len.tip.pnl_today: Yield minus payed fees: net economic result today after deducting all transaction costs.
len.tip.pnl_yesterday: Yield minus payed fees: net economic result yesterday after deducting all transaction costs.
len.tip.pnl_month: Yield minus payed fees: net economic result this month after deducting all transaction costs.
len.tvl_low_note: TVL too low. Withdrawals may become difficult.

slen.autodeploy_tip: Detects new USDC in the wallet and deploys it automatically. Mode 'Best pool' picks the protocol with the highest APY. 'Specific pool' always deploys into a protocol you choose.
slen.autodeploy_running: ⚠ Auto-Deploy check is running right now.
slen.min_deposit_tip: Minimum amount that must accumulate in the wallet before Auto-Deploy triggers. Smaller amounts are ignored and keep growing.||Leave empty or 0 = no minimum (deploys from 1 USDC).
slen.fixed_max_tip: Limits how much USDC may be invested into this pool per Auto-Deploy run. Excess balance stays in the wallet for the next run.||Leave empty or 0 = no limit.
slen.best_max_tip: Limits how much USDC may be invested per Auto-Deploy run in best-pool mode. Excess balance stays in the wallet for the next run.||Leave empty or 0 = no limit.
slen.min_apr_tip: Minimum APY (in percent) a protocol must offer for Auto-Deploy to invest there. Protocols below this threshold are skipped.
slen.tvl_at_activation_tip: Market TVL at the time of the deposit into this protocol.
slen.tvl_guard_tip: If this protocol's market TVL falls below the threshold, 100 % of the capital is withdrawn automatically.
slen.tvl_guard_tip_addr: If this protocol's market TVL falls below the threshold, the capital is withdrawn 100 % automatically — optionally sent to an address. While the threshold is undercut, “Best pool” does not invest into this pool.
slen.tvl_threshold_tip: If the market TVL falls below this value, the position is withdrawn 100 %. While the threshold is undercut, “Best pool” does not invest into this pool.
slen.send_to_tip: Recipient address for the withdrawn capital. Without an address it stays in the wallet (and may be redeployed by Auto-Deploy).
slen.tvl_threshold_gt0: The TVL threshold must be greater than 0.
slen.pool_unusable_no_guard: Pool not usable – no TVL protection needed
slen.deposit_tip: Deposits USDC from the wallet directly into a lending protocol. Auto-Deploy is paused briefly during the transaction.
slen.withdraw_tip: Withdraws USDC from a lending protocol back into the wallet. Auto-Deploy is paused during the transaction – switch it off permanently if you do not want the funds redeployed right away.
slen.no_pool_data_hint: No pool data available yet. Check the "Status" row above to see whether the Lending Bot is running – after starting it only takes a few seconds until the first tick.
slen.pool_info_only: The pool is listed for information only – deposit, withdraw and TVL protection are disabled.
slen.pool_inactive_new_position: ⚠ Pool currently inactive – a new position will be opened.
slen.autodeploy_paused: Auto-Deploy is paused automatically during the transaction.
slen.withdraw_autodeploy_hint: Auto-Deploy is paused during the transaction. Switch it off permanently (Auto-Deploy → Manage) if you do not want the funds redeployed right away.

sliq.no_premium_wallet: No premium wallet configured. It is created automatically during installation (bin/install.sh) — on an existing installation you may need to reinstall.
sliq.premium_requirements: Requirement: the current version of FORGE public. On an outdated version the premium service is deactivated automatically. If the Liquidity Bot is stopped manually, automatic payment is deactivated with it (premium delivers data specifically for this bot).
sliq.premium_explain_1: The premium service connects this bot to the FORGE public data service: automatically checked new pool offers (address, token, fee tier verified against the chain), continuous market scoring/scanner data for pool rating, and priority support contact.
sliq.premium_explain_2: The cost is settled automatically every hour from the premium wallet stored here (separate from the bot capital) — as long as the balance lasts and the service is activated below.
sliq.premium_explain_3: This premium service is tailored to the Liquidity Bot and is managed and paid for independently of other bots.
sliq.premium_on_first_payment: Premium service activated – first payment sent, data will be up to date shortly
sliq.offers_intro: Pools checked by the premium data service that this bot does not know yet. Adopting only makes the pool known — no capital is ever invested in the process.
sliq.offer_exception_hint: ⚠️ This pool triggers a technical stop criterion (Token-2022 and/or adaptive fees), but has explicitly been approved as an exception:
sliq.offer_rejected_hint: ❌ At least one delivered value does not match the chain. This pool cannot be adopted.
sliq.offer_unsupported_hint: ⚠️ This pool meets a technical stop criterion without an accepted exception and is not supported.
sliq.adopt_explain_1: Adopting makes this pool known to the bot (deactivated, no cleanup reinvest).
sliq.adopt_explain_2: No capital is invested in the process.
sliq.adopt_explain_3: Releasing it for real capital happens separately afterwards via "Activate pool", just like for every other pool.
sliq.manual_desc: Invests the wallet balance into a pool of your choice.
sliq.manual_tip: Invests the investable wallet balance into the pool selected here – right away with “Start now” and then on every hourly cleanup run. “No investment” leaves free capital in the wallet; dust and the SOL reserve are still maintained every hour.
sliq.min_deposit_tip: If less than this amount of available capital is in the wallet, the bot does not open a new position and cleanup does not reactivate a pool.||Prevents tiny positions whose transaction fees eat up the yield.||Leave empty or 0 = no minimum.
sliq.max_deposit_tip: Limits how much USDC the bot uses to open a position or to reopen it after an exit.||Example: limit 500 USDC → the position starts with at most 500 USDC, the rest stays liquid.||Does not apply to the investment into the pool selected here.||Leave empty or 0 = no limit.
sliq.dust_desc: Automatically swaps small token remainders to USDC at the end of every cleanup run.
sliq.dust_tip: After every cleanup run small remainders of known pool tokens are often left in the wallet (e.g. amounts that do not divide exactly after a swap). The dust sweep swaps these remainders to USDC automatically so they do not sit around unused. The lower and upper bound define which value counts as "dust".
sliq.dust_range_hint: Remainders in this range are swapped to USDC automatically after every cleanup. Below: negligible, left alone. Above: left alone; without an investment into a selected pool, swapped to USDC after 24 h as well.
sliq.dust_min_lt_max: The lower bound must be smaller than the upper bound.
sliq.dust_min_lt_max_zero: The lower bound must be smaller than the upper bound (both ≥ 0).
sliq.cleanup_running: Cleanup running… (may take up to 5 min)
sliq.sol_low_premium: Not enough SOL in the premium wallet for the hourly payment.
sliq.premium_active_tip: Premium data service active – the edge forecast runs on delivered data.
sliq.premium_inactive_tip: Premium not active – the edge forecast in the opportunity table is delivered by the premium data service. Trailing Stop and TVL protection keep working independently.
sliq.dryrun_pending_tip: The automatic test run (deposit.js --dry-run) is still going – waiting for the first pool data (~1 bot cycle after adoption).
sliq.cannot_deactivate_tip: The pool holds an open position. Withdraw everything first, then deactivate.
sliq.range_tip: Shows the current position range and allows a manual rebalance (the position is closed and reopened with a new range).
sliq.range_summary: Show the range and rebalance manually.
sliq.fee_claim_summary: Governs how fee income is handled.
sliq.risk_tip: Two independent protection mechanisms:||Trailing Stop (TS): closes the position when the pool value falls by an adjustable percentage below its previous high (high-water mark).||TVL protection: withdraws the capital as soon as the pool's TVL falls below an adjustable threshold.||With both mechanisms the withdrawn capital can optionally be swapped to USDC and sent to an address.
sliq.deposit_refpool: Price reference pool – deposits not possible
sliq.pool_deactivated_tip: The pool is deactivated – activate it first, then deposit.
sliq.no_pool_data_hint: No reliable pool data yet – check the "Status" row above to see whether the Liquidity Bot is running.
sliq.pool_off_hint: 🔒 Pool deactivated – it takes no capital (no cleanup reinvest) until it is activated again. Settings can still be saved.
sliq.pool_idle_hint: ⚠ Pool idle – no open position. Settings can still be saved.
sliq.pool_types_hint: Saving applies the values of a row immediately to ALL pools of that type and overwrites existing individual settings there (risk management modal).
sliq.tvl1_gt0: TVL threshold 1 must be greater than 0 (or left empty).
sliq.tvl2_gt0: TVL threshold 2 must be greater than 0 (or left empty).
sliq.overwrite_prefix: This overwrites Trailing Stop and TVL protection values for
sliq.also_deactivates: In addition, all pools of this type are deactivated (no more cleanup assignment).
sliq.pool_enable_hint: Afterwards the pool can take capital again (deposits and cleanup reinvest).
sliq.pool_disable_hint: No more capital is invested into the pool (no cleanup reinvest, no deposit) until it is activated again.
sliq.pool_cleanup_inactive_hint: Cleanup now only invests into the pool selected under Cleanup → Manual, so this mode currently has no additional effect. The existing position, manual deposits/withdrawals, and risk management keep running unchanged.
sliq.risk_summary_tip: Rules to limit losses and secure gains.
sliq.no_econ_data: No economic scorer data yet — will be updated on the next cron run.
sliq.ac_only_hint: ⚠️ Only available if auto compounding is < 100% or disabled.
sliq.hwm_pending: ℹ The reference value will be established at the next snapshot (≤10 min).
sliq.hwm_reset_title: Reset the high-water mark to the current pool value
sliq.ts_auto_needs_premium: The recommendation is computed centrally and delivered through the premium service. Without an active premium service there is nothing to adopt.
sliq.ts_auto_no_data: No reliable recommendation exists yet for this pool or its pool type. The advisor needs enough closed positions to prove an advantage over your current setting.
sliq.ts_auto_tip: Determine drawdown 1 and 2 automatically. Instead of fixed values, FORGE measures how much this pool swings in normal operation and sets the thresholds just above it — wide enough to absorb ordinary swings, tight enough to trigger on real drops.||The values are recalculated every twelve hours. Where they currently come from is shown next to this switch.||If Auto is off or nothing is available, the values in the two fields above apply; if those are empty too, 1.75 % and 0.75 % take over.
sliq.cooldown_range_err: The cleanup cooldown must be between 1 and 24 h.
sliq.tvl_stage1_tip: If the pool TVL falls below this value, the configured share is withdrawn — preset to 100 % and swapped to USDC.
sliq.tvl_stage2_tip: Optional second stage for a staggered exit (lower threshold). Off by default — then only stage 1 reacts.||If both stages are active, the threshold here must be lower than on stage 1 and both shares must add up to 100 %.
sliq.tvl1_err: The TVL threshold must be greater than 0.
sliq.tvl2_err: Stage 2: the TVL threshold must be greater than 0.
sliq.tvl_escalation_err: The stage 1 threshold must be greater than stage 2 (escalation).
sliq.tvl_actions_err: The actions of stage 1 and stage 2 must add up to 100 %.
sliq.advisor_intro: The Range Advisor recommends a narrower range for this pool. The current position will be
sliq.rebalance_duration_hint: This takes about 1–2 minutes and cannot be cancelled. Deposits and withdrawals are blocked during that time.
sliq.confirm_reopen_1: The position will be closed and reopened. That takes
sliq.confirm_reopen_5: . Deposits and withdrawals are blocked during that time.
sliq.rebalance_queued: ✓ Rebalancing started. The bot will execute it on the next tick.
sliq.pool_state_failed: The pool state could not be loaded.
sliq.deposit_not_possible: – deposit not possible at the moment.
sliq.arm_intro: First deposit into this pool: trailing stop and TVL protection level 1 will be activated with the pool-type/default values – adjustable under Risk Management.
sliq.oor_deposit_blocked: Position is out of range – deposit not possible
sliq.wallet_too_low_token_mode: Wallet balance too low for token amount mode
sliq.no_open_position: No open position – withdrawal not possible.
sliq.withdraw_usdc_hint: Liquidity worth this USDC amount is removed proportionally.
sliq.wallet_read_failed_retry: The wallet balance could not be read. Please try again.
sliq.fee_claim_tip:
Controls from which amount fees are claimed and what happens to them afterwards.

Auto compounding: reinvest fees into the pool right away (fully or partially).

Send to: optionally send remaining fees to an address – swapping to USDC first if needed.
sliq.deposit_tip:
Adds capital to the existing pool position, or opens a new position if the pool is currently inactive.

Two modes:
• USDC amount: wallet USDC is swapped into both pool tokens.
• Wallet coins: existing pool tokens are used directly, no swap.
sliq.withdraw_tip:
Removes liquidity from the existing pool position. Optionally the withdrawn coins can be swapped to USDC and/or sent to an address before they stay in the wallet.

Two modes:
• USDC value: liquidity worth this USDC amount is removed proportionally.
• Token amount: proportional removal anchored on one pool token — both sides come back proportionally.
sliq.sim_tip: Expected or measured value development of the LP position with a stake of 1,000 USDC.||measured: real snapshot values (active pools only)|projection: extrapolated linearly from total return p.a.|simulation: from model APR for inactive pools
sliq.total_return_tip: Expected annual return of the position:|realized APR from fees|− rebalance cost|− reinvest efficiency loss|± token value movement|||The token value movement can be positive or negative. If the value of the held tokens falls, the total return tips into the negative — even when fees are doing well.
sliq.confidence_tip: Data maturity of the scorer: how many days of fee_history exist?|Scales from 0 % (3 days) to 100 % (14+ days).|Below 3 days: the pool automatically lands in "hold" (no invest signal).|Inactive pools: 60 % at most (APR estimated, not measured).
sliq.token_value_tip: Annualised change of the LP value in USDC over the last days (max 7 d).|Captures token price movements — complementary to the fee view (realized APR).|With sharply falling tokens this value can become clearly negative, even when fees are doing well.
sliq.pnl1d_tip: LP value change over the last 24 hours.|Acute indicator for sudden price crashes.|Trigger for "withdraw": if the value drops by more than 10 %, the pool is marked withdraw immediately (hysteresis still has to agree).
sliq.min_amount_tip: Fees are only claimed once their total value has reached this amount.
sliq.reinvest_share_tip: Share of the claimed fees that is reinvested into the pool right away. The rest stays in the wallet or is forwarded via "send to".

health.share_not: Not transmitted are wallet addresses, balances, pools, positions, profits, hostname or IP addresses – and no free text.

health.share_confirm_off: Stop sharing data? No further data will be sent to the FORGE Master.
health.svc.host-oom.name: RAM / Swap – Issues
health.svc.host-oom.description: Counts processes the operating system killed due to memory pressure (OOM killer). Every occurrence is reported immediately – unlike the other checks, this isn't a snapshot but a record: the counter stays correct even if the shortage happened between two checks and was long over by the time of the next one.
health.svc.host-memory.name: RAM / Swap – Usage
health.svc.host-memory.description: Share of memory still available for new work (MemAvailable – includes cache that can be freed instantly on demand). The swap file is factored in too: if it's nearly full, it slows the whole server down long before programs actually crash.
health.svc.host-disk.name: Disk
health.svc.host-disk.description: Usage of the filesystem holding FORGE, its databases, and its logs. If it fills up, the bots can no longer write to their databases – a state they can't recover from on their own.
health.svc.forge-nexus.name: FORGE Nexus
health.svc.forge-nexus.description: Central FORGE router. All external API requests from the bots pass through the Nexus – it handles rate limiting, RPC caching, and forwards notifications.
health.svc.forge-lendingbot.name: LendingBot
health.svc.forge-lendingbot.description: Bot 2 – lends USDC across several lending protocols (Kamino, Loopscale) and collects interest daily.
health.svc.forge-liquiditybot.name: Liquidity Bot
health.svc.forge-liquiditybot.descriptio: Bot 3 – provides capital in concentrated liquidity pools (Orca Whirlpools) and earns trading fees from DEX activity.
health.svc.forge-settings.name: Settings Server
health.svc.forge-settings.description: Internal admin server (LAN, port 3200) – bot control, configuration, maintenance mode.
health.svc.forge-premium.name: Premium
health.svc.forge-premium.description: Nostr identity and Message Center – keeps the persistent relay pool open, delivers (Master) or receives (Fork) the Premium blob.
health.svc.premium-ingest.name: Premium Delivery (Receiving)
health.svc.premium-ingest.description: Receiving the Premium data (edge forecast, market data) the Master delivers every 10 min (core/premium/server.js → bots/liquidity/lib/premium-ingest.js). Shows how old the last successfully integrated blob is – independent of whether the Nostr relay connection status itself is green.
health.svc.jupiter.name: Jupiter API
health.svc.jupiter.description: Decentralized swap aggregator on Solana. Automatically finds the cheapest route for swapping tokens – all buys and sells by the bots go through it.
health.svc.helius.name: Helius RPC
health.svc.helius.description: Helius's Solana RPC node. All blockchain queries – wallet balances, transaction status, pool data – go through this service.
health.svc.kamino.name: Kamino
health.svc.kamino.description: Lending protocol on Solana. The LendingBot lends USDC and other tokens here at variable interest rates.
health.svc.loopscale.name: Loopscale
health.svc.loopscale.description: Another lending protocol on Solana. Complements Kamino in the LendingBot portfolio and often offers different interest rates.
health.svc.orca.name: Orca
health.svc.orca.description: CLMM liquidity protocol on Solana (concentrated liquidity). The Liquidity Bot provides liquidity here in narrow price ranges and earns fees from trading.
health.svc.telegram.name: Telegram API
health.svc.telegram.description: Notification service. All alerts from the bots – errors, starts, stops – arrive as Telegram messages. If Telegram is down, warnings stay silent.
health.svc.hetzner-web.name: Hetzner Web Server
health.svc.hetzner-web.description: Web server at Hetzner hosting the FORGE dashboard. No bot depends on it directly – but without it, the dashboard isn't reachable from outside.
health.svc.filebase.name: Filebase
health.svc.filebase.description: Primary storage host for the Premium blob (core/premium/publish-blob.js, every 10 min). Shows the result of the last upload attempt – no dedicated check request, pure evaluation. If the upload fails, the backup host takes over automatically; shown here so a persistent outage doesn't go unnoticed.
health.svc.nostr_relay.description: Nostr relay for the FORGE Message Center (support chat, Premium delivery). Shows the connection status of forge-premium's persistent relay pool.
